summary: Master the art of reporting and communicating MEL findings. Enroll in our training to elevate your skills and drive meaningful change in your organization.
lede: Reporting and Communicating MEL Findings helps you turn project outcomes, evaluation evidence, and learning into communication that stakeholders can understand, trust, and use. You will learn to build clear storylines, explain methods and limitations, and make recommendations relevant to donors, leaders, communities, and technical teams. The course develops practical skills in structuring reports, choosing meaningful indicators, translating analysis into insights, using visuals effectively, and writing for different audiences. You will also create ready-to-use reporting assets, including templates, dashboards, and presentation packs.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who must translate MEL data into actionable insights across various sectors.
modules: Knowing Your Audience and Reporting Purpose
Structuring Strong Reports and Learning Products
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of monitoring and evaluation concepts and experience in data collection and reporting.
